slides.say: Here's a use state trick that saves work on every render.
This looks fine, but create initial todos runs on every single render. React only uses the result the first time and throws it away after.
Pass the function itself, without parentheses. React calls it only once, during the first render.

slides.text: Use it when the initial value is expensive: parsing, big arrays, localStorage.
slides.say: Use this when the initial value is expensive, like parsing data or reading local storage.
